SELECT    CASE      -- A) col 15 = 0 → ตาม system (Net × Qty, ไม่ลด)      WHEN ISNULL($[$38.U_SLD_Dis_Amount.NUMBER], 0) = 0        THEN CAST($[$38.14.NUMBER] * $[$38.11.NUMBER] AS DECIMAL(19,6))      -- B) col 15 <> 0 → คำนวณ Amount + Check ปกติ (Inclusive)      WHEN $[$38.U_SLD_Check.0] = 'Y'        THEN CAST(          $[$38.14.NUMBER] * $[$38.11.NUMBER]          - $[$38.U_SLD_Dis_Amount.NUMBER] / 1.07          AS DECIMAL(19,6))      -- B) col 15 <> 0 → คำนวณ Amount + Check ปกติ (Exclusive)      ELSE        CAST(          $[$38.14.NUMBER] * $[$38.11.NUMBER]          - $[$38.U_SLD_Dis_Amount.NUMBER]          AS DECIMAL(19,6))    END
